ValidationRule.description: This is the validation, when Apple Case - 'Provisioning' type is closed : Comment ID and Closure Reason is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(Type) = 'Apple Pay' && TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'Provisioning' && OR (ISBLANK(Comment_ID__c) , ISBLANK(TEXT(Apple_Pay_Closure_Reason__c ))) && TEXT( Status ) = 'Closed'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Comment ID and Closure Reason are mandatory while Closing the 'Provisioning' case.
